summary_en: On October 28, 2026, TONE executed a block trade to acquire 750,000 shares (3.3% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at ¥423 per share via ToSTNeT-3, totaling ¥317.25 million, within a framework authorized by the Board on August 28, 2026 (upper limit: 750,000 shares, ¥400 million, through May 31, 2027).
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: TONE Co., Ltd. executed a treasury stock acquisition on October 28, 2026, via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) at the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company acquired 750,000 shares at ¥423 per share, representing 3.3% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a total of approximately ¥317.25 million. The price reflects the closing price (including final special quotations) on October 27, 2026. This execution represents a specific implementation within the broader authorization granted by the Board of Directors on August 28, 2026, which permits acquisition of up to 750,000 shares for a maximum of ¥400 million through May 31, 2027, using market purchases including ToSTNeT-3. As of September 30, 2026, no shares had been acquired under this authorization prior to this block trade.
